buttons.label: Explore Listings / Search
buttons.action: Navigates to /explore with selected category and city query params

buttons.label: List Your Room
buttons.action: Navigates to /onboarding/owner or /create-listing

buttons.label: Continue with Google
buttons.action: Triggers Firebase GoogleAuthProvider popup sign-in

buttons.label: I'm Looking for a Room / Roommate
buttons.action: Selects role 'seeker' and navigates to /onboarding/seeker

buttons.label: I Have a Room / Flat to Rent
buttons.action: Selects role 'owner' and navigates to /onboarding/owner

buttons.label: Find Compatible Roommates
buttons.action: Validates inputs, saves user profile with 10 quiz answers to users/{uid}, redirects to explore/dashboard

buttons.label: Complete Profile & Create Listing
buttons.action: Saves owner profile and navigates to listing creation

buttons.label: Save / Bookmark Room
buttons.action: Toggles roomId in users/{uid}.savedRoomIds via useUserProfile.toggleSavedRoom

buttons.label: Save / Bookmark Flatmate
buttons.action: Toggles targetUid in users/{uid}.savedProfileIds via useUserProfile.toggleSavedProfile

buttons.label: Connect / Send Request
buttons.action: Creates connection doc in 'connections' collection with status 'pending' (enforces FREE_CONNECT_LIMIT = 5)

buttons.label: Accept Request
buttons.action: Updates connection status to 'accepted', creates/retrieves chat room, unlocks phone numbers

buttons.label: Decline Request
buttons.action: Updates connection status to 'rejected'

buttons.label: Call / Contact
buttons.action: Opens ContactModal; displays phone/WhatsApp only if connection is 'accepted'

buttons.label: Chat Now
buttons.action: Invokes getOrCreateChatRoom and navigates to /chat?room={id}

buttons.label: Pause / Resume Listing
buttons.action: Toggles listing status between 'active' and 'paused'

buttons.label: Confirm Still Available
buttons.action: Updates lastConfirmedAt timestamp to prevent 30-day freshness expiration

buttons.label: Delete Listing
buttons.action: Opens Delete Confirmation modal and permanently removes listing document

buttons.label: View Answers
buttons.action: Opens ApplicantScreeningAnswersModal with applicant's questionnaire responses

buttons.label: Filters
buttons.action: Opens AdvancedFiltersModal

buttons.label: Factory Reset Entire Database
buttons.action: Triggers complete deletion of all 21 Firestore collections and current Auth account

buttons.label: Clean Demo & Seed Data
buttons.action: Batch deletes docs tagged with 'seed_user_' or '@nestmate-seed.com'

modals.trigger: Filter button on ExplorePage or BrowseRooms
modals.purpose: Comprehensive filter sheet for budget, furnishing, move-in window, amenities, dietary, smoking, alcohol, bachelors-friendly

modals.trigger: Call/Contact button on RoomCard or SeekerCard
modals.purpose: Displays verified phone, WhatsApp direct link, or prompt to connect first if unaccepted
Allows seekers with 'team_up' housing intent to form groups to co-rent larger apartments

modals.trigger: During listing creation or application flow
modals.purpose: Configures and collects owner-specified questions (food preference, work hours, visitors, deposit agreement)

modals.trigger: View Answers button on OwnerDashboard applicants tab
modals.purpose: Shows responses provided by the applicant to the owner's questionnaire

modals.trigger: Rendered on OwnerDashboard if owner status is unverified
modals.purpose: Upload electricity bill, property tax receipt, or rental deed to receive Tier 3 Verified Owner badge

modals.trigger: Unauthenticated user actions (e.g. clicking Connect or Save)

cards.displays: Title, price/month, locality, city, furnishing, amenities preview, compatibility badge, owner verified check, save heart, CTA
Compact grid card optimized for marketplace: rent pill, partner share, distance, badges, action buttons
Flatmate profile: name, avatar, age, profession, budget, move-in, compatibility circle percentage, traits tags, connect button
Prospective tenant card with fit rating, budget alignment, lifestyle compatibility, contact button
